description: Authorizes posting a message to a Slack channel after content review and channel authorization.

unboundSignalReasons.contentApproved: Result of an independent content-review check; not a value the Intent itself declares.
unboundSignalReasons.channelAuthorized: Confirms the target channel is one this integration is permitted to post to; independently verified, not caller-declared from the Intent.

outcome.reason: Message post authorized. Content review and channel authorization requirements were satisfied.
Message post rejected because one or more required policy conditions were not satisfied.
